release_status: Unreleased local worktree; VERSION unchanged; no commit, tag, or release created.

behavior.bug: A wished suit remained active after a player laid a card of that suit, incorrectly blocking normal rank/suit matching on the following turn.
behavior.fix: A non-Jack Mau-Mau play consumes the previous suit wish. A newly played Jack replaces the current wish.
behavior.jack_on_jack: Still disabled by default; when enabled, a Jack can be played on a Jack and the newly chosen suit replaces the old wish.

regression_coverage: Wished suit is played, old wish clears, and the next seat can match the new top rank in another suit.
Rendered card selection, wish picker, Play action, and AI turns exercise the same flow.
Rendered Jack-on-Jack remains available when enabled and replaces the prior wish.

limits: Browser verification used Chromium at 390x844; physical iOS Safari was not tested.
